title: Number of Ways to Wear Different Hats to Each Other
description: Calculate number of ways to assign distinct hats to people using bitmask DP.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize dp[1 << n] = 0, dp[0] = 1
2. Iterate through hats 1 to 40
3. For each hat, update dp mask backwards
4. If person can wear hat, update dp[mask | (1 << person)] += dp[mask]
5. Return dp[(1 << n) - 1]

steps.note: Initialize DP table with size 8 (2^3) representing all possible person assignments.
Start processing hat 3. Person 0 can wear hat 3.
Start processing hat 4. Person 0 and 1 can wear hat 4.
Start processing hat 5. Person 1 and 2 can wear hat 5.
